TestExistingDefaultsUnchanged.test_confi.note: The SQLite processing inbox is retired (PG-C2 #641; docs/postgresql-architecture.md §11.5): Files for Processing is an upload queue of managed objects, so StorageConfig has no processing_dir and no /data/for_processing fallback, and a set PRKS_FOR_PROCESSING_DIR is refused at start whatever its value. The test now checks the remaining root-relative components (pdfs/, the log) under a bootstrap-file root.
